parameters.name: AcrRegistryInfo
parameters.description: Details of the Container Registry Enterprise Edition instance that hosts the image of the init container.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that the value is unique among different requests. The token can only contain ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotency](~~25693~~).

parameters.name: Container
parameters.description: The new configurations of the container group.

parameters.name: ContainerGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the elastic container instance that you want to update.

parameters.name: Cpu
parameters.description: The number of vCPUs that are allocated to the elastic container instance.

parameters.name: DnsConfig.NameServer
parameters.description: The IP addresses of DNS servers.

parameters.name: DnsConfig.Search
parameters.description: The search domains of the Domain Name System (DNS) server.

parameters.name: ImageRegistryCredential

parameters.name: InitContainer
parameters.description: The information about the new init container.

parameters.name: Memory
parameters.description: The size of the memory that is allocated to the elastic container instance. Unit: GiB.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

parameters.name: RestartPolicy
parameters.description:
The restart policy of the elastic container instance. Valid values:

*   Always: Always restarts the instance if a container in the instance exits upon termination.
*   Never: Never restarts the instance if a container in the instance exits upon termination.
*   OnFailure: Restarts the instance only if a container in the instance exists upon failure with a status code of non-zero.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags that are bound to the instance.

parameters.name: UpdateType
parameters.description:
The update type. Valid values:

*   RenewUpdate: full updates. You must specify all relevant parameters to update the elastic container instance. For a parameter of the list type, you must specify all the items contained in the parameter even if you want to update only some of the items. For a parameter of the struct type, you must specify all the members even if you want to update only some of the members.
*   IncrementalUpdate: incremental updates. You may specify only the parameter that you want to update. Other related parameters remain unchanged.

Default value: RenewUpdate.

parameters.name: Volume
parameters.description: The volumes that are mounted to the instance.
